draft.subject: Re: The VAT invoice -- and your first project
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

Thanks for your patience on the VAT invoice -- that ticket is still open on our side and I'm staying on it. For reference, a VAT number can be added to invoices from billing settings, and I'm glad to walk through it with you.

On the setup side, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting the first one created is usually what makes the rest click. Would a short call this week work? I'll keep it brief and help you get that first project started.

Best,
Priya
